_comment: Registry for scripts/weekly_scorecard.py. start_ts = epoch seconds of the bot RESTART that activated the change (NOT commit time - all four below shipped 2026-06-11 but apply on restart). start_ts=0 -> NOT_STARTED, skipped; set it after the activating restart (or pass --default-start-ts for ad-hoc runs). New experiments self-register by appending an entry. NOTE: all four share one activation restart (2026-06-11 18:03:12 UTC), so attribution is BUNDLE-level until they diverge.

experiments.label: NEAR_TARGET_EXIT_ENABLED (B5 near-target mcp_take_profit + B6 planned-TP-first + trailing age-out floor) — does letting winners reach the planned TP raise whole-trade PnL / realized R:R without dropping WR
experiments._activation: Set NEAR_TARGET_EXIT_ENABLED=true in .env, restart the bot, then set start_ts to the restart epoch (NOT commit time). Until start_ts>0 this is NOT_STARTED and skipped. Single-variable A/B: do NOT flip other flags during this run. EXIT-shape change on a NO_EDGE bot -> measures realized-R:R redistribution, not alpha; ceiling is break-even.
